name: Ever Prime Residences
shortDescription: A large condominium near Karon Beach with units from about 51 to 179 sqm.
description:
Ever Prime Residences is a condominium project in Karon, near Karon Beach on Phuket's west coast. Listings describe units from about 51 sqm one-bedroom layouts up to roughly 179 sqm four-bedroom homes.

Foreign buyers can hold units as freehold within the 49% foreign quota. Sources differ on the developer (Able Land Co., Ltd. or Phuket Plus) and on completion (Q2 2027 or March 2028), so we show neither until confirmed.

The starting price shown is the lowest we found. Message us on WhatsApp for the current price list.
